# non2DArray

<link-summary>Checks whether a value is not a non-empty two-dimensional array.</link-summary>

<web-summary>non2DArray() — Checks whether a value is not a non-empty two-dimensional array. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/array</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function non2DArray<T>(arr: T | Array<Array<unknown>>): arr is T;
```

`non2DArray(value)` is the same test as `!is2DArray(value)`. The prefix exists so that a guard clause reads as a
sentence rather than as a negation — see [](validation-conventions.md).

An empty array qualifies as "not two-dimensional", because [`is2DArray`](is2DArray.md) requires at least one row.

A caveat on types: the guard is declared as a type predicate, but it only narrows usefully when the value's own
type already names `unknown[][]` as one of its cases. In the branch where the value _is_ a matrix, TypeScript is
left with `never` rather than a matrix type, so reach for [`is2DArray`](is2DArray.md) or
[`require2DArray`](require2DArray.md) when the matrix has to be used after the check. As a plain boolean answer,
`non2DArray` is exact in every case.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type                         | Description         |
| :-------- | :--------------------------- | :------------------ |
| `arr`     | `T \| Array<Array<unknown>>` | The value to check. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` if the value is not a non-empty array of arrays; otherwise `false`.

In TypeScript the guard narrows `arr` to `T` inside the branch.

## Examples

### What counts as not two-dimensional

```javascript
non2DArray([1, 2]); // => true — flat
non2DArray([]); // => true — no rows
non2DArray("abc"); // => true
non2DArray([[1], [2]]); // => false
```

### Reporting why a value was rejected

<tabs group="code">
<tab title="TypeScript" group-key="ts">
<code-block lang="typescript" src="non2DArray.ts" include-symbol="validateShape"/>
</tab>
<tab title="JavaScript" group-key="js">
<code-block lang="javascript">
function validateShape(rows) {
  if (non2DArray(rows)) {
    return "Expected a matrix: a non-empty array of rows.";
  }
  if (nonConsistent2DArray(rows)) {
    return "Every row must have the same number of columns.";
  }
  return null;
}
</code-block>
</tab>
</tabs>
